channel.title: Logos Ecosystem Development
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Logos Ecosystem Development

item.title: Activity Hub
item.description: The activity hub serves two main purposes, which are related to the life cycle of Logos movement participants (better word?).

item.title: liblogos
item.description: C++ SDK library providing the core API for developing Logos modules, enabling inter-module communication and access to platform services.

item.title: Logos Web SDK
item.description: JavaScript/TypeScript SDK enabling web applications to interact with Logos blockchain, storage, and messaging infrastructure.

item.title: Atomic Swaps
item.description: Enables trust-minimized peer-to-peer swaps of shielded assets without revealing details to a third party or the public, bootstrapping early, decentralized private liquidity.

item.title: Bridges & Cross-Chain Infrastructure
item.description: Absolutely mandatory for onboarding assets and users to the privacy L1 through secure, privacy-preserving cross-chain infrastructure.

item.title: Circle Content Management System
item.description: Enable circles to collaboratively manage knowledge, documentation, and content while maintaining privacy and censorship resistance.

item.title: Derivatives & Perpetual Trading
item.description: Attracts professional traders and generates high trading volumes by allowing for leveraged positions on shielded assets while protecting traders’ strategies.

item.title: Launchpads & Token Issuance
item.description: Facilitates the fair and private launch of new tokens directly into the shielded ecosystem, allowing new communities to form and fundraise without public scrutiny or the risk of sniper bots.

item.title: Liquid Staking Derivatives (LSDs)
item.description: Unlocks staked capital by allowing users to stake the native token to secure the network while receiving a liquid, shielded token that can be used in private DeFi.

item.title: Local P2P Marketplace
item.description: Escrowed, classifieds-style P2P trade marketplace enabling local communities to trade goods and services privately, supporting local circular economies, resilience, and formalizing informal economies.
